keyEvents.text: Goal! FC Cologne 0, Bayer 04 Leverkusen 1. Aleix García (Bayer 04 Leverkusen) from a free kick with a right footed shot to the top left corner.
Facundo Medina (Bayer 04 Leverkusen) is shown the yellow card.
Tom Krauß (FC Cologne) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
First Half ends, FC Cologne 0, Bayer 04 Leverkusen 1.
Second Half begins FC Cologne 0, Bayer 04 Leverkusen 1.
Mikey Moore (FC Cologne) is shown the yellow card.
Linton Maina (FC Cologne) is shown the yellow card.
Afonso Moreira (Bayer 04 Leverkusen) is shown the yellow card.
Edmond Tapsoba (Bayer 04 Leverkusen) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Joël Schmied (FC Cologne) is shown the yellow card.
Borna Sosa (FC Cologne) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, FC Cologne. Ísak Jóhannesson replaces Tom Krauß.
Substitution, FC Cologne. Malek El Mala replaces Marius Bülter.
Substitution, FC Cologne. Reigan Heskey replaces Linton Maina.
Substitution, Bayer 04 Leverkusen. Jonas Hofmann replaces Malik Tillman.
Substitution, FC Cologne. Luca Waldschmidt replaces Mikey Moore.
Substitution, FC Cologne. Alessio Castro-Montes replaces Sebastian Sebulonsen.
Goal! FC Cologne 0, Bayer 04 Leverkusen 2. Patrik Schick (Bayer 04 Leverkusen) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the top left corner. Assisted by Ibrahim Maza with a through ball.
Substitution, Bayer 04 Leverkusen. Loïc Badé replaces Facundo Medina.
Substitution, Bayer 04 Leverkusen. Robert Andrich replaces Ibrahim Maza.
Goal! FC Cologne 1, Bayer 04 Leverkusen 2. Saïd El Mala (FC Cologne) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the top right corner. Assisted by Malek El Mala with a cross.
Aleix García (Bayer 04 Leverkusen) is shown the yellow card.
Jahmai Simpson-Pusey (FC Cologne) is shown the yellow card.
Jonas Hofmann (Bayer 04 Leverkusen) is shown the yellow card.
Second Half ends, FC Cologne 1, Bayer 04 Leverkusen 2.
